message.content: **Decision: Buy.** Apple's fiscal 2024 (ended September 28, 2024) results support a purchase: total net sales of $391.0 billion (+2% year over year), operating income of $123.2 billion (up from $114.3 billion), and operating cash flow of $118.3 billion. Services revenue grew 13% to $96.2 billion and total gross margin improved to 46.2% from 44.1%. Net income of $93.7 billion was down from $97.0 billion only because of a one-time $10.2 billion net tax charge tied to the EU State Aid Decision — which is why **diluted EPS for fiscal 2024 came in at $6.08**, down from $6.13 in fiscal 2023 despite stronger underlying operations. With the quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), I bought 44 shares at a limit of $222.75, a total of about $9,801 — within the $10,000 per-order cap, the only order placed today (so well under the $20,000 daily cap), a buy order in a permitted name, at a limit price essentially at the market, with no funds moved out of the account.
